causal_diagnostics.funding_cashflow: aggregate realized funding PnL must be positive; fold funding PnL should be positive in at least four of six folds
causal_diagnostics.relaxation_uplift: reference is compared only after passing against a preregistered level-only nondeployable diagnostic

portfolio.capacity_rule: effective side budget is min(0.20,K*0.03); excess remains cash
portfolio.name_count_rule: K=max(6,floor(N/4)) after retaining the lowest-volatility floor(4N/5) symbols
portfolio.name_weighting: equal per sleeve with ASCII residual reconciliation
portfolio.required_carry_spread: mean selected-short funding level must exceed mean selected-long funding level by more than 1e-12 per day
